name: image_classification.v1
description: Classifies an RGB image and ranks its classes by descending confidence score.

image.description: RGB image in planar CHW format with three channels ordered Red, Green, then Blue and values normalized to [0, 1].

id.description: Non-negative class IDs, ranked from highest to lowest confidence score. IDs are stable within a brick variant and need not be contiguous. At least one class is reported.

score.description: Confidence scores in [0, 1], aligned with id and ordered from highest to lowest. Scores need not sum to one and are not required to be calibrated across variants.

name.description: UTF-8 class names aligned with id and score, padded with zero bytes. Every row contains a non-empty name.
